_comment.model: Kimi model key (provider/model format, as defined in ~/.kimi/config.toml [models] section)
_comment.compile-startup-md: If true, compile IDENTITY.md + INSTRUCTION.md + MEMORY.md into KIMI.md
_comment.fallback: If true, enable quota-based fallback to fallback_backend when usage exceeds usage_threshold
_comment.fallback_backend: Backend to fall back to: pi, cc, or openclaw. Quota-aware backends (gemini/agy) are excluded to prevent transitive fallback chains
_comment.usage_threshold: Usage percentage (0-100) at which to trigger fallback (default: 95)
